translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Luk Tikak

content: Nip An Aŋgek Kun Girapan

Pen ñin namb kun siŋak, Jiysis Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan ak amiy, nuk biynimb di Gor yip jimñiy ayniŋgamb minim tep ak aŋgñakniŋ, bi Gor nup tap simboŋgep yomb gok, bi low tiysa gok, bi minim tuŋgasikep gok apiy,
nup aŋgyak, “An nip aŋgek, ap Gor aŋgniŋep korip biy, biynimb gok kuyip yuk yokyiŋg, minim aŋgñiyiŋg girapan?”
Aŋgey aŋgak, “Yand nimbip pen, aŋgniŋep bap aŋgniŋniŋg gispiyn.
Jon biynimb gok kuyip ñiŋg pikñak ak, gos nuk key niŋiy gak akaŋ, Gor aŋgek gak?”
Aŋgek, kiyk key aŋgniŋ aŋgniŋ giy aŋgyak, “‘Gor aŋgek Jon biynimb gok kuyip ñiŋg pikñak aŋgon,’ nuk aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Kun ak minim nup ak, yenen ma niŋbim aŋgniŋgamb.’
Pen Jon gos nuk key niŋiy, biynimb gok kuyip ñiŋg pikñak aŋgon, biynimb guniy, Gor aŋgek apiy gek niŋbay rek, chinup kamb jiw pikayniŋgambay aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgiy, Jiysis nup aŋgyak, “Jon ap biynimb gok kuyip minim aŋgñiy, ñiŋg pikñiy gak ak, chin ma niŋbun. Gos nuk key niŋiy gak akaŋ, Gor aŋgek gak aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgey, kuyip aŋgak, “Nimb yip pen ma aŋgñimbim rek, yand pen; an aŋgek ap gispiyn ak, nimbip ma aŋgñiniŋgayn aŋgak.”
Jiwda Biyomb Gok Bi Gor Woŋg Giñiyiŋgipay Gok Timey Giyak Rek, Ñinuk Nup Kunep Giniŋgambay Aŋgiy Paydoŋ Ay Aŋgak
Pen Jiysis kuyip paydoŋ ay aŋgak, “Bi bap wayn woŋg ak gi yimiy, biynimb woŋg nup giniŋgambay gunap kuyip aŋgay, nuk am miñmon paryomb okok mindeniŋgamb.

Pen wayn maŋgiy pik giniŋgamb ñin ak, binuk bap aŋgyokiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Am aŋgey, wayn maŋgiy yip gunap ñey, dand winimin aŋgniŋgamb.’ Aŋgek amjakek, biynimb wayn woŋg gi mindeniŋgambay gok, nup pik pik ay, yikop aŋgyokey andkind winiŋgamb.
Kun gey, bi wayn woŋg nop nimb ak, bi bap pen aŋgyokek amniŋgamb. Pen nup kunep pik pik ay, yikop aŋgyokey andkind winiŋgamb.
Kun gey, bi kisenimb bap aŋgyokek amjakek, nup tapin yimb pikiy, lipiŋg dam mis akyaŋ yokniŋgambay.
“Kun geniŋgambay, bi woŋgday nop nimb ak, Ñi mapin yand ak yoken, minim aŋgeniŋgamb niŋniŋgambay aŋgiy, yokniŋgamb.
Yokek amjakek, biynimb wayn woŋg gi mindeniŋgambay kun gok aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Ñi wip biy, nop wayn woŋg ak, nuk dinimuŋ rek ayip. Nup pisnep pikay, chin dun aŋgniŋgambay.’
Kun aŋgiy, nup lipiŋg dand mis okok amiy, pisnep pikayey kumniŋgamb. Pen kun geniŋgambay, bi woŋgday nop nimb ak kuyip yerginiŋgamb?

Nuk apiy, biynimb kun gok kuyip pikay, woŋgday kun ak biynimb gunap kuyip pen aŋgek, kond mindeniŋgambay aŋgak.” Jiysis kun aŋgek, biynimb niŋmindeyak gok aŋgyak, “Mer! Chinup Jiwda biynimb kun ma ginimuŋ. Biynimb kisenimb gok aŋgek, ma kond mindeniŋgiy aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, kuyip niŋkuskus giy aŋgak, “Baybol buk ak, minim kun ak rek tikiy aŋgyak:

content.text: ‘Bi korip gep gok, kamb bap tep ma gek kirgiyak ak pen, miñiy korip sap namb yomb biyaŋ ak piŋiyñiy mindip aŋgiy’ tikyak.

content: “Biynimb kamb ar kun ak apyap pikniŋgambay gok, tapin nep pikniŋgamb. Pen kamb kun ak puŋgjiw apyapiy, biynimb aybirikniŋgamb gok, pisnep piksimbjakniŋgamb aŋgyak.”
Jiysis kun aŋgek, “Chinup nep asap aŋgiy,” bi low tiysa gok sek, bi Gor nup tap simboŋgep yomb gok sek nup kor gun aŋgiy niŋyak ak pen; biynimb kuŋaynep niŋmindeyak niŋiy, pirikiy kirgiyak.
Rom Biyomb Siysa Nup Takes Pikjun Akaŋ Mer Aŋgyak

Pen minim aŋgak gok niŋiy, nup yergiy dand kor amjun aŋgiy, am biynimb gunap kuyip mimuŋg giy aŋgyak, “Nimb biynimb tep rek silok ay, am tom giy, nup minim gunap aŋgem, pen yerip aŋgonimuŋ niŋiy, nup dand gapman kor yomb ak amniŋgambun aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgey, nup am aŋgniŋiy aŋgyak, “Tiysa. Chin niŋbun; yip yerip gos niŋniŋgambay aŋgiy minim key gunap ma apan; biynimb gok kuyip Gor minim aŋgñiniŋg akaŋ, yerip aŋgniŋg, yipund giy nep apan.
Kun ak yerginjun. Rom gapman biyomb Siysa nup, takes pikjun akaŋ, mer?”
Kiyk yesek tom giyak kun ak, Jiysis key niŋiy, kuyip aŋgak,

“Maniy takes pikpay kun ak bap yip diñem niŋiyn aŋgak.” Aŋgek, diñey niŋiy aŋgak, “Maniy bak ak, kawnan an ker mindiy, yimb tikyak kun ak, an yimb ak mindiy gip?” Aŋgek aŋgyak, “Siysa kawnan ak mindiy, yimb nuk ak mindiy gip aŋgyak.”
Aŋgey, kuyip aŋgak, “Kun ak Siysa yip ginimimb aŋgip gok, nup ginimimb; Gor yip ginimimb aŋgiy niŋimb gok, nup ginimimb aŋgak.”
Pen minim aŋgak kun ak, kiyk niŋey, miker nup bap, dinimuŋ rek ma ayek, wal aŋgyak. Bi gos tipaŋgiy niŋiy aŋgip aŋgiy, pen minim gunap ma aŋgiy, minim gomb pisnep kurgak.
Biynimb Kumiy Tip Tikjakpay Akaŋ Aŋgyak
Biynimb gunap, biynimb kumiy ma tikjakpay aŋgiy, gos ak niŋyiŋgipay. Biynimb kun gok kuyip, “Sanjiwsiy biynimb” aŋgyiŋgipay.
Kiyk gos kun ak niŋyiŋgipay rek, ap Jiysis nup nembnemb giyiŋg aŋgyak, “Tiysa. Bi Gor minim aŋgep Mosis; minim bap chinup tikiy aŋgak:

content.text: ‘Bi bap biyn diy, ñapan tikiy mer yikop kumeniŋgamb, numam nuk bap pen, biyn kun ak diy, ñapan nup ak aŋgiy tikniŋgamb aŋgak.’

content: Kun ak, bi kiñiŋ sek onep ar ak mindeniŋgambay; numam nind ak biyn diy, ñapan tikiy mer; yikop kumniŋgamb.
Kumek, numam namb pen, biyn kun ak diy, kunep ñapan tikiy mer; yikop kumniŋgamb. Kun gek, numam namb ak pen diniŋgamb.
Ak kunep ñapan tikiy mer; yikop kumniŋgamb. Kun gi dam dam, numam onep ar ak maŋgiysek ñapan tikiy mer; yikop kumniŋgambay.
Kisen biyn kun ak kunep kumniŋgamb.
Pen kumiy tikjakniŋgambay apan ak, biyn nokom binuk di onep ar ak ayniŋgamb kun ak, kisen an ker mindeniŋgamb aŋgyak.”
Aŋgey, Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Miñiy mindpun ñin biy, biyn gok bi dipay; bi gok biyn dipay.
Pen Gor biynimb nuk gok kumiy tikjakiy, biyn gok bi ma diniŋgambay; bi gok biyn ma diniŋgambay.
Pen tip ak ma kumniŋgambay; Gor ñi pañ nuk gok mindiy, enjol nuk gok per mindpay rek mindeniŋgambay.

Biynimb kumiy tikjakpay minim ak, Mosis kunep aŋgiy tikak ak niŋbun. Gor mon bind maŋlaŋ gek namb ak mindiy, basind nind kumyak gok yimb aŋgiy, Mosis nup aŋgak, ‘Yand Gor yesek bap mer; Ebraham, Aysek, Jekop Gor kiyk yand mindpiyn aŋgak.’
Biynimb nind kumyak gok, ‘Gor kiyk mindpiyn’ aŋgak rek chin niŋbun; biynimb kim mindpay akaŋ, kumbay gok Gor niŋimb, maŋgiysek kim mindpay.”
Jiysis kun aŋgek, bi low tiysa gunap aŋgyak, “Tiysa. Minim yipund giy nep aspan aŋgyak.”
Minim aŋg tep gak kun ak pirikiy, kisen minim gunap nup ma aŋgniŋyak.
Yip Yenen Kiyŋ Yomb Key Yimb Ak Ma Apay Aŋgak
Pen Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Biynimb gok, Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak nup, Depiyt Biyomb nuk aŋgniŋgiy ak pen; yenen nup Depiyt tik dand amiy apiy gek, tikpay ñi ak nep apay.
Depiyt nuk key, Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak nup minim aŋgiy, Baybol buk day ‘Sam’ apay ak tikiy aŋgak:

content.text: ‘Biyomb Gor, Biyomb yip ak nup aŋgip, “Nand ñin yipund kind yip okok mindiy,
mind dand amiy, biynimb nip alemb alemb ñimbay gok kuyip, tomb beŋ nand okok ayen, tawbirikniŋgamban aŋgip” aŋgiy’ tikak.

content: Pen Depiyt Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak nup, Biyomb yand aŋgak kun ak, yenen nup Depiyt ñinuk ak nep apay aŋgak.”
Bi Low Tiysa Gok Mind Tep Ma Gipay Aŋgak
Pen biynimb gok niŋmindyakniŋ, Jiysis binuk gok kuyip aŋgak,

“Nimb bi low tiysa gok gipay rek ginimimb rek ayip ak, niŋrep yimb ginimimb. Kiyk gipay ar ak, okok taŋgon yimb chinup anep aŋgyaŋ aŋgiy, chech paryomb gok yimiy, nan-gep korip ak amiy, biyomb bispay ar ak bisgiy, tap yomb ñimbay ñin ak, am biyomb bisginiŋgiy tip ak dipay.

Pen biyn yandiw gok korip tap kuyip okok, chinup nimb tikaŋ aŋgiy lip lip giyiŋg, Gor nup aŋgniŋsipun aŋgiy, minim paryomb yesek yesek ar gok apay. Kun gipay ak, kisen yiwur yomb key yimb ak, diniŋgambay aŋgak.”
